source.paper: Cordero et al., Covalent radii revisited, Dalton Trans. (2008), 2832-2838, Table 2
source.scope: Full software-table cross-check against ASE's Cordero dataset; no independent experimental fit or digitization of the paper
source.conventions: PyRPMD documents C(sp3) and Mn/Fe/Co low-spin choices; all match ASE numerically
source.missing_value_note: ASE's entries after Cm are placeholders, excluded from the 96-value comparison; PyRPMD requires explicit values
